Rules.InvariantScript:
// Defines shared visual settings for the app, including colors, typography, corner radius, and drop shadow.

    AppTheme = { 
        Color: {
            Background: ColorValue("#fafafa"), 
            Section: ColorValue("#ffffff")
        },
        Font: Font.'Segoe UI', 
        FontSize: {
            regular: 14, 
            header: 20
        }, 
        BorderRadius: 8,
        DropShadow: DropShadow.Semilight
        
    };

// Defines the page name and ribbon configuration. Each ribbon action has an enabled flag and tooltip text. These settings configure controls that reference them; they do not implement the actions themselves.

    AppSettings = {
        pageName: "Cloud Flows",
        pageRibbon: {
            
            // Ribbon settings for the inventory view.
            View: {
                back: {
                    enabled: true,
                    tooltip: "Back"
                }, 
                refresh: {
                    enabled: true, 
                    tooltip: "Refresh data"
                },
                quickview: { 
                    enabled: true, 
                    tooltip: "Toggle Quick View pane"
                }

            },

            // Ribbon settings for the inventory record form.
            Form: {
                back: {
                    enabled: true,
                    tooltip: "Back"
                },
                environment: {
                    enabled: true,
                    tooltip: "Go to Environment"
                }
            }
        }
    };

// Defines the type of a single connector operation.

    InventoryOperationType := Type(
        {
            operationId: Text
        }
    );

// Defines the type of a connector, including its identifier, display name, and table of operations.

    InventoryConnectorType := Type(
        {
            connectorId: Text,
            connectorDisplayName: Text,
            operations: [InventoryOperationType]
        }
    );

// Defines the type of a flow trigger, including its operation and the connector associated with that operation.

    InventoryTriggerType := Type(
        {
            operationId: Text,
            connectorId: Text,
            connectorDisplayName: Text,
            operationDisplayName: Text
        }
    );

// Defines the type of the nested properties record, including connector usage, flow metadata, ownership, timestamps, trigger details, and status.

    InventoryPropertiesType := Type(
        {
            powerPlatformConnectors: [InventoryConnectorType],
            displayName: Text,
            environmentId: Hyperlink,
            createdBy: Text,
            createdByUser: Text,
            createdAt: DateTime,
            lastModifiedAt: DateTime,
            ownerId: Text,
            ownerIdUser: Text,
            lastModifiedBy: Text,
            workflowEntityId: Text,
            flowTriggerType: Text,
            trigger: InventoryTriggerType,
            status: Text
        }
    );

// Defines the type of a complete inventory resource, combining resource-level metadata with its nested properties.

    InventoryResourceType := Type(
        {
            id: Text,
            name: Text,
            type: Text,
            tenantId: Text,
            kind: Text,
            location: Text,
            resourceGroup: Text,
            subscriptionId: Text,
            managedBy: Text,
            properties: InventoryPropertiesType
        }
    );

// Defines a table type whose rows use InventoryResourceType.
    
    InventoryTableType := Type([InventoryResourceType]);

// Parses JSON text into the declared inventory table type. The JSON is expected to contain an array matching that schema.

    ParseInventory(jsonText: Text): InventoryTableType =
        ParseJSON(jsonText, InventoryTableType);

// Creates a named formula that transforms varInventory into a table with flattened resource, property, and trigger fields. The connector table is retained, while additional fields provide comma-separated connector identifiers and names, connector counts, and a total operation count across all connectors. As a named formula, nfInventory is recalculated as needed when its dependencies change; it does not populate a separate collection. 

    nfInventory =
        ForAll(
            varInventory As resource,
            {

                // Copies the shared resource-level metadata.
                
                    id: resource.id,
                    name: resource.name,
                    type: resource.type,
                    tenantId: resource.tenantId,
                    kind: resource.kind,
                    location: resource.location,
                    resourceGroup: resource.resourceGroup,
                    subscriptionId: resource.subscriptionId,
                    managedBy: resource.managedBy,

                // Flattens the nested properties into top-level fields. The User-suffixed fields currently copy createdBy and ownerId; they do not resolve user names or use the corresponding User fields.

                    propDisplayName: resource.properties.displayName,
                    propEnvironmentId: resource.properties.environmentId,
                    propCreatedBy: resource.properties.createdBy,
                    propCreatedByUser: resource.properties.createdBy,
                    propCreatedAt: resource.properties.createdAt,
                    propLastModifiedAt: resource.properties.lastModifiedAt,
                    propOwnerId: resource.properties.ownerId,
                    propOwnerIdUser: resource.properties.ownerId,
                    propLastModifiedBy: resource.properties.lastModifiedBy,
                    propWorkflowEntityId: resource.properties.workflowEntityId,
                    propFlowTriggerType: resource.properties.flowTriggerType,
                    propStatus: resource.properties.status,

                // Flattens the trigger details. Counts the trigger as 1 when its operationId is not blank, otherwise as 0; this does not count multiple triggers.

                    triggerOperationId: resource.properties.trigger.operationId,
                    triggerConnectorId: resource.properties.trigger.connectorId,
                    triggerConnectorDisplayName: resource.properties.trigger.connectorDisplayName,
                    triggerOperationDisplayName: resource.properties.trigger.operationDisplayName,
                    triggerCount: If(IsBlank(resource.properties.trigger.operationId), 0, 1),

                // Retains the connector table and creates comma-separated lists of connector identifiers and display names. Counts connector rows and sums the number of operation rows across all connectors, without deduplicating them.

                    connectors: resource.properties.powerPlatformConnectors,
                    connectorIds: Concat(resource.properties.powerPlatformConnectors, connectorId, ", "),
                    connectorNames: Concat(resource.properties.powerPlatformConnectors, connectorDisplayName, ", "),
                    connectorCount: CountRows(resource.properties.powerPlatformConnectors),
                    operationCount: Sum(
                        resource.properties.powerPlatformConnectors,
                        CountRows(operations)
                    )

            }
        );
